title: Critical Quasilinear Schrödinger Equations on the Heisenberg Group: Existence and Nonexistence
summary: We study the quasilinear Schrödinger equation \begin{align*} -Δ_{\mathbb{H}} u +V(ξ)u-Δ_{\mathbb{H}} (\left|u\right|^{2α})\left|u\right|^{2α-2} u= λ\left|u\right|^{q-2}u + \left|u\right|^{p-2}u \quad \text{ in } \mathbb{H}^N, \end{align*} where $Δ_{\mathbb{H}}$ is the Kohn Laplacian on the Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}^N$, $4α \frac12$, and $2αQ^{*}$ is the critical exponent, $Q=2N+2$ being the homogeneous dimension and $Q^{*}=\frac{2Q}{Q-2}$. For $p=2αQ^{*}$ and $λ>0$, we obtain a nontrivial solution, assuming that the potential is bounded below by a positive constant and is either…
